content: Sunrise Community Clinic (晨光社區診所) is open Monday to Saturday and closed on Sundays and public holidays. Morning session 09:00-12:00, afternoon session 14:00-17:30, evening session 18:00-21:00. Which doctor sees patients in which session depends on the doctor's schedule.
88 Zhongshan Road, Yancheng District, Kaohsiung (高雄市鹽埕區中山路88號). We are a 3-minute walk from the nearest MRT exit.
07-555-0123. Our front desk answers the phone Monday to Saturday from 08:30 to 20:30.

You can register at the front desk, by phone, or through this online assistant's staff. Walk-in registration closes 15 minutes before the end of each session. Please bring your NHI card (健保卡) and a photo ID.
First-time patients please arrive 15 minutes early to fill in a form. Bring your NHI card, photo ID, and a list of the medicines you are taking now. Children must come with a parent or guardian.

You can cancel or change an appointment free of charge up to 2 hours before the session starts. Please call the front desk. If you do not show up three times in a row, we may ask you to register in person.
We accept cash, credit cards and mobile payment. NHI (National Health Insurance) is accepted. Patients without an NHI card pay the full self-pay price, which is decided by the doctor.

Total fee = the doctor's registration fee + the co-payment for your patient type. Co-payment: adult NT$150, child under 12 NT$50, senior aged 65 or over NT$50, catastrophic illness card holder (重大傷病卡) NT$0. The registration fee differs by doctor and is listed in the doctor schedule. Medicine and test fees are not included and are decided by the doctor.
We have no car park. Scooters can park in front of the clinic. Cars can use the public car park about 100 m away (NT$30 per hour).
Seasonal flu shots are available from October to January, Monday to Friday during the morning and afternoon sessions. Please call the front desk to book a time.
We are not an emergency room. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, loss of consciousness or another emergency, call 119 or go to the nearest hospital emergency room immediately.
Our online assistant cannot give a diagnosis, medicine advice or any medical advice. Please see a doctor in person. For a serious or urgent problem, call 119.
